editorialDecisions.detail: Translated60unique Japanese paragraphs,7lesson metadata and7question sets directly from isolated canonical Japanese. All7reading fields absent exactly as source. No other locale input.

Preserved resident consent/scope, preferences, individual bathing hydration/meal timing plans, medical reporting recipient, facility escalation and no unsupervised untrained technique. Retained grooming action versus choice rights and comfort verification after completion.

Kept belongings movement/disposal consent separate from cleaning request; laundry versus disinfection, standard precautions before diagnosis, dirty/clean flow, and no inferred chemical concentration/temperature. Environment includes access to call button and mental reassurance.

Kept five abuse types, facts/observations and protection at suspicion stage, appropriate facility plus municipality reporting pathways, privacy not blocking legitimate protective reporting, and legal-decision limits. Team roles preserve physician/dentist instructions for required nursing medical assistance, ST scope and current individual meal-plan verification.

Distinguished planned/provided service, assessment/planning/implementation/evaluation and observed resident results versus counts or completed paperwork. Art captions remain contextual without clinical/technique certification.
